review_basis: All actual user turns of the selected session, with complete dialogue retained in the evaluator-only selection artifact. These labels do not initialize memory and never enter the Editor or Reader. Original official references are unchanged.
selection_timing: Prespecified lexical source shortlist after the first three format receipts, before comparative mechanism outcomes; source labels completed while the first B0 arm was running.
not_independent_units: Multiple labels can concern one source session and the same actual update; inference clusters by user.
coverage_limit: No scoped override, explicit condition-preservation change, or historical erratum is verified in this 32-item shortlist. This does not establish absence in the complete dataset. Cancellation, ordinary changes, semantic enrichment and uncertainty are present.
own_formed_state_requirement: Before/after states must come from the actual arm run. Missing initial targets and no semantic change are reported; no ideal reference initialization.
